'''Tragtath''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] of the [[Bareesh]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]] who was active during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Tragtath led regular expeditions by hundreds of [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] and experts to search for lost artifacts and treasures in ancient vaults on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kor Bareesh]], the [[Throneworld/Legends|throneworld]] of the Bareesh clan. However, the majority of these expeditions resulted in failure due to the harsh conditions on the world.<ref name="Lords of Nal Hutta" />
